The FloPlast 110mm vent terminal provides essential protection for soil and vent drainage systems. Constructed from lightweight yet robust uPVC, this black terminal efficiently prevents birds, squirrels, and large debris from entering the pipework, maintaining clear drainage flow. Its solvent weld connection ensures a secure and watertight seal, making it a reliable component for new build installations and repair projects. This durable fitting is designed for longevity and performance within external drainage applications.
